_comment: Single source of truth for WHICH model serves each lane, what it costs, and
how to steer its reasoning. Adding a vendor or a model is a JSON edit — no Go.
Secrets never live here: a provider names the ENV VAR that carries its key.
Capability bindings are overridable at boot without a rebuild:
Run `api --print-models` to dump the catalog and the active bindings.
thinkingOff is the body fragment that forces reasoning OFF. It is per-PROVIDER
because the same model answers to a different knob depending on how it is
reached — measured live against each endpoint:
via DashScope   : that fragment is ignored; the honored knob is
qwen3.8-max: ON = 53 completion tokens of which 47
reasoning, with reasoning_content set; OFF = 3 completion
tokens, no reasoning_content, same correct answer.
Getting this wrong costs nothing at boot and everything at runtime: the
chaperone lane would quietly resume full reasoning (4,000-7,000 completion
tokens/turn, 40-66s) — the exact regression documented on NewChatResolver.

_capabilityComment: capabilities defaults to ["chat", "tools"] when omitted. A lane binds only a
chat model — boot fails otherwise, so MODEL_CHAT=dashscope/qwen-image-3.0-pro
The image / embedding / rerank rows are catalog metadata, not yet callable:
they answer on other endpoints (/images/generations, /embeddings, /rerank) and
each needs its own provider kind when a feature calls for it. They are listed
because ONE DashScope key reaches all of them — so the image and multi-modal
work later is a JSON edit plus an adapter, not another vendor survey.
🚨 Every dashscope wire name below was checked against this workspace's own
GET /models on 2026-09-02. Names that PAI served but DashScope does not
dropped rather than carried over: a catalog that names a model the channel
cannot serve is exactly the silent lie this file exists to prevent.
Two names surprise: GLM 5.3 answers to "ZHIPU/GLM-5.3" (the bare
"glm-5.3" is access-denied, and "glm-5.3-flash" is a 404 — the flash is
"ZHIPU/GLM-5.3-Flash"). Both need the product ACTIVATED in the Bailian
console first; before activation every call is a 400 that reads like a bad
request rather than a billing setting.
_reasoningComment: Measured 2026-09-02 with internal/gateway/probe_reasoning.py (median of 3 —
single samples swing by a third and will invent a control that is not there):
model              default  off   verdict
deepseek-v4-pro       106    0    off works; effort: no effect
deepseek-v4-flash      89    0    off works; effort: no effect
qwen3.8-max            61    0    off works; effort rises 63->86
qwen3.7-max           347    0    off works; effort rises 65->408
kimi-k3                50    0    off works; effort rises 44->51
kimi-k2.6               0    0    never reasons by default
kimi-k2.7-code         59   61    🚨 off IGNORED — see below
glm-5.2               253    0    off works; effort: no effect
glm-5.1               195    0    off works; effort: no effect
ZHIPU/GLM-5.3          49  ERR    🚨 refuses to stop — see below
🚨 GLM 5.3 (and its Flash) answer enable_thinking:false with an outright
error: 「该模型始终思考，不支持关闭思考；请使用 low、high 或 max」. So they
carry thinkingOffUnsupported + defaultReasoningEffort:low — which makes a
chaperone turn send the effort knob instead of the rejected one. Without
that, every chaperone turn on GLM 5.3 would be a hard 400.
🚨 kimi-k2.7-code ACCEPTS enable_thinking:false and reasons anyway (59
tokens default, 61 with the knob). That is the silent-and-expensive case, so
it is marked thinkingOffUnsupported too: better to send nothing and know it
always reasons than to send a field that buys us a comforting lie.
_priceComment: priceUsd is cache-miss USD per 1M tokens. A model with priceUsd omitted is
UNPRICED: llm_call records a NULL/zero cost rather than a wrong number, and
--print-models flags it. The DashScope rows below are deliberately unpriced —
Aliyun bills in CNY at its own rates, and guessing them would silently corrupt
every cost comparison the catalog exists to make. Fill them in from the
Bailian console before drawing any cost conclusion from llm_usage.
2026-09-12 · 两行 deepseek 直连价改了，因为原来那两行是错的（V4 时代的旧价，
按它算出来的钱只有真实的三分之一）。现价取自 api-docs.deepseek.com 的
deepseek-flash 0.30/1.20 USD per 1M。闲时是峰时的一半，我们记贵的那个——
成本估高了只是保守，估低了会让一次降级看起来没必要。
deepseek-v4-flash 这个线名在直连口上被官方指向了 V4.1 Flash（实测：请求它，
回包的 model 字段是 deepseek-flash），所以两行同价。经 DashScope 时不是这样：
deepseek-v4-flash 仍是老的 V4 Flash；截至 2026-09-18，GET /models 已新增独立的
deepseek-v4.1-flash，非流式实测可用且接受 enable_thinking:false。同一个线名在
两条通道上不是同一个模型——这正是价格和绑定都必须按通道记的原因。

_laneComment: chat      — chaperone: coach turns, writing turns, card grounding (降级 allowed)
fastChat  — chaperone: the per-status studio router's short prompts
eval      — flagship: framework review, 整稿体检, 证据地图, evaluation, reading router.
评估走旗舰模型绝不降级 — a model bound here MUST be flagship:true,
enforced at boot so an override typo cannot quietly downgrade it.
All capability classes route through DashScope so one key and one bill cover every vendor;
each class remains independently overridable. Dialogue deliberately moved to
deepseek-v4.1-flash on 2026-09-18 after live protocol checks; change one class
at a time with MODEL_DIALOGUE / MODEL_REFLEX / ... or speed and cost stop being
_bindingComment: 2026-09-03 · 这一组绑定来自 routebench 的实测，不是猜的。三档换了，三档留着；
留下来的理由和换掉的理由一样是数据。完整报告见
reflex  deepseek-v4-pro -> qwen3.7-flash   300ms vs 1s，3 vs 3 tokens，五个候选结构全对
compose deepseek-v4-pro -> kimi-k3         6.9s vs 10.8s，191 vs 506 tokens，质量并列
digest  deepseek-v4-pro -> deepseek-v4-flash  1.6s vs 2.9s，77 vs 98 tokens，两者都 5 分
dialogue 原留 deepseek-v4-pro：它是 2026-09-03 routebench 唯一在 lite 阅读陪练上拿 5 分的候选。
2026-09-18 按产品选择切到独立上架的 deepseek-v4.1-flash；上线前已实测非流式、流式、
thinking-off 与工具调用。该选择不是原 routebench 结论，后续仍需用同一题集复测教学质量。
review / assess 留 deepseek-v4-pro：assess 上 kimi-k3 直接空回复、glm-5.3 报 400。
review 上所有候选都只有 2 分——它们全都把一份半成品框架判成了 ready。
那是 prompt 的问题，换模型解决不了。
_classComment: A class says how much INTELLIGENCE a call needs — not which feature made it.
Two calls on one page can sit in different classes; two unrelated features can
share one. reasoning is the class's requirement and overrides the model's
defaultReasoningEffort; a per-request ReasoningEffort still wins over both.
latencyBudgetMs is a TARGET that routebench scores against — never a timeout,
because mid-turn a slow answer beats no answer.
Every class starts bound to the same model the three old lanes used, so
introducing classes changed ROUTING SHAPE only, not which model serves a
request. Re-pointing them is what routebench exists to inform — one class at a
time, or the measured difference stops being attributable to anything.
chat / fastChat / eval survive as aliases (dialogue / reflex / assess), so
MODEL_CHAT, MODEL_FAST_CHAT and MODEL_EVAL keep working.

reflex.label: 反射 — 一个标签或一次路由选择，没有自由文本

dialogue.label: 陪练 — 学生当场看得见的对话轮，一次只问一个

compose.label: 结构生成 — 从已陈述的输入派生一个 schema 形状的产物

review.label: 审阅 — 读学生的成果并作判断，判错有代价

assess.label: 过程评估 — rubric 报告 / 回顾 / 周报；绝不降级

digest.label: 摘要 — 长输入短输出，压缩而不判断

draw.label: 画图 — 受众画像与头图；答在 /images/generations，不是对话口

search.label: 预留 — 联网检索，需要多轮工具循环

_fallbackComment: Tried in order when a lane's bound model has no key in the environment. Keeps
local dev and CI working with whichever single key is present, and lets prod
survive a DashScope outage by dropping back to the direct vendor endpoints.
